name: BergBot
title_zh: 先报风险再谈路线的瑞士山区徒步审查员
tagline_zh: 出发前把路线、天气、雪况、装备逐项过一遍，输出 GPX 和风险报告。本地运行不传数据，专治「看着挺好」的盲目进山。
tagline_en: Audit route, weather, snow, gear before you go. Local-first, outputs GPX + risk report. Kills the 'looks fine'.
desc_en: Check everything before you go to the mountains. Open-source, local-first Swiss hiking agent: find, audit, report, GPX — warnings first, never 'safe'.
why_zh: 默认不信任任何单一数据源，交叉核对后才给结论；报告里风险永远排在风景前面，机制上逼你先看坏消息。
why_en: Distrusts any single data source by default, cross-checks before concluding. Risks always precede scenery—forces bad news first.
limit_zh: 只覆盖瑞士境内阿尔卑斯山区，需自备 OpenTopoMap 密钥；不替代官方雪崩公报，恶劣天气下建议直接放弃行程。
limit_en: Swiss Alps only; requires your own OpenTopoMap key. Not a substitute for official avalanche bulletins—skip trip in severe weather.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Swiss hiking auditor: warnings first, never 'safe'
